title: opscale-graph — graph.json
description: Deterministically BUILT (never authored) traceability graph: the whole module as a NESTED HIERARCHY of lightweight {id, ref} nodes — module → subprocesses → steps → operations → composed operations. Every element carries its ontology id plus a JSON Pointer `ref` into the file that owns its content (process/dbml/bpmn/sipoc); no titles, names, or bodies are duplicated — all are derivable by dereferencing `ref`. The interactive graph.html is a deterministic projection of this file with the source content inlined at render time. The island-free guarantee is now 'every ref resolves to something real', checked semantically.

ref.description: A REFERENCE into process.json — module (software/domain/subdomain) is never duplicated here.

id.description: First-level operations use opCode (SP-XX-YY-[CL]ZZ); composed children use composedOpCode (…-[CLO]AA).

ref.description: JSON Pointer into bpmn.json: first-level ops at /operations/{SP}/{step}/{idx}; composed ops append /operations/{j}.

operations.description: Composed child operations of a logic op (recursive, logic ops only). Absent/empty for crud and output ops.
